bashCommands: for id in r-*/; do node ~/forge-evidence/pi-atdd/plt-82-evaluator/run-hidden.mjs "${id}tree" "~/forge-evidence/pi-atdd/plt-82-evaluator-verdicts/${id}"; done
for id in r-*/; do echo "=== $id"; wc -l "${id}result.diff"; find "${id}tree/src" -type f; done

V=~/forge-evidence/pi-atdd/plt-82-evaluator-verdicts; for id in r-*; do work=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$V/$id/hidden-result.json')).run.workDirectory"); node --experimental-strip-types "$V/review-probes.mjs" "$id" "$work/result" > "$V/$id/review-probes.json" 2> "$V/$id/review-probes.stderr"; (cd "$work/result" && npm_config_cache="$V/$id/.npm-cache" npm test) > "$V/$id/submitted-tests.log" 2>&1; done
